facts.business: Platinum Industries Limited is a diversified specialty chemicals company focused on developing customised solutions for polymer and industrial applications, including PVC and CPVC additives, metallic soaps, specialised lubricants, and other performance chemicals.

capacity_or_capex.item: Palghar Facility / Working capital requirements of the Company / General Corporate Purpose

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to fire incident at subsidiary M/s. Platinum Polymers and Additives on 7th July 2025; insurance claim receivable of Rs 98.19 million recognised but claim does not meet virtual certainty of realisation as at 31st March 2026, unable to determine adjustments required to gross carrying amount of investment in subsidiary of Rs 100.00 million and loan to subsidiary of Rs 6.00 million.

key_risks: Fire incident at subsidiary factory premises affecting net assets and investment carrying value
Insurance claim uncertainty for subsidiary's fire damage
Revenue recognition risk due to potential manipulation of timing of transfer of control
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include: Purchase and Sale of goods with Rivaan Plastchem LLP (Relative of Director is Director in the Company); Investment in Platinum Stabilizers Egypt LLC (Subsidiary Company); Purchase and Sale of goods with Platinum Global and Platinum Polymers & Additives Private Limited (Associate Entity); Loan Given and Loan Repaid to Platinum Polymers & Additives Private Limited.
